sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next Open Weight Released Aug 26 2026 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next is an AI model released by Qwen on Wednesday, Aug 26 2026, 12 days after Qwen3.8-27B. It is an open-weight model — the trained weights are available to download and run. It is a 125B parameter model with a 262k token context window. sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3.8-Flash-Next is a multimodal, ultra-sparse Mixture-of-Experts model. It has 125B parameters, including an additional 51B N-gram embedding table, while activating 6B parameters per token. The architecture combines four main ideas: GDN + QSA: three of every four layers use Gated DeltaNet to compress history; the fourth uses Qwen Sparse Attention for precise long-range retrieval ...
